verdict.rationale: Community evidence indicates AutoGen can execute agent code inside a fresh Docker container by default, providing a form of sandboxed execution, but this is a community observation rather than documented first-party guidance and can be disabled. There is no evidence of fine-grained, per-tool permission controls letting an engineering-lead restrict specific actions an agent may take. missing for 10: documented tool-level permission/allowlist system, first-party sandboxing docs, evidence of granular access control configuration.
